# Myco

> Your agents learn from the work you have already done.

Myco captures coding sessions. Its own agent turns them into durable project knowledge (spores), alongside captured plans. Project instructions return to coding agents at session start; relevant spores and plans return with each prompt. Tools let agents search further and record discoveries.

A Deployment is one Myco server on Cloudflare or your own machine. Member machines capture Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and Cline through global agent configuration. Separately registered runners lend signed-in coding agents to Myco's own work. Learning needs a runner; Work on a schedule starts off. Context for sessions, Code map and Learning are on by default per project.

## Getting started

- [Join a Myco](https://myco.sh/quickstart.md): Install, accept an invitation, connect your dashboard account, and see a new session on Today.
- [Run your own Myco](https://myco.sh/self-hosting.md): Create a server with guided setup; manual owner commands, backups and recovery.
- [Runners](https://myco.sh/runners.md): Register a machine, sign in to its coding agents, manage capacity and update between runs.
- [Updating Myco](https://myco.sh/upgrade.md): Update machines, runners and Deployments; guided move from Myco 1.4 and manual cutover reference.

## Using Myco

- [The dashboard](https://myco.sh/dashboard.md): Get started checklist, sessions, knowledge, Myco's work, machines and administration.
- [How Myco learns](https://myco.sh/how-myco-learns.md): Four outcomes, registered runners, schedules and context for agents.
- [Agents](https://myco.sh/agents.md): Six capture agents, global configuration, delivery and visibility.
- [Agent tools](https://myco.sh/agent-tools.md): The seven MCP tools, project arguments and shipped skills.
- [External agents](https://myco.sh/external-agents.md): Project access keys, hosted reviewers and plugin-only use.
- [Configuration](https://myco.sh/configuration.md): Server settings, default-on project switches, run limits and machine capture folders.
- [Troubleshooting](https://myco.sh/troubleshooting.md): Status checks, capture, sign-in, runners and removal precautions.

- [Actors & boundaries](https://myco.sh/architecture/actors-and-boundaries.md): Users, coding agents and Myco's own agent.
